description: Implementation of the D3D11 IndexBuffer class for ANGLE project, managing index buffer resources, mapping, unmapping, and format retrieval.

classes.name: IndexBuffer11
classes.description: D3D11 implementation of an index buffer for ANGLE, handling buffer creation, mapping, unmapping, and format management.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the index buffer with specified size, type, and usage.

methods.name: mapBuffer
methods.description: Maps the buffer for writing, with specified offset and size.

methods.name: getIndexType
methods.description: Returns the type of indices stored in the buffer.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Resizes the buffer if needed, updating index type.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Discards current buffer contents, preparing for new data.

methods.name: getIndexFormat
methods.description: Returns the DXGI format corresponding to the index type.
